public class FooTests
{
    static List<int> shared = new List<int>();
    static int counter;
    static readonly List<int> Items = new List<int>();
    static readonly Dictionary<string, int> Map = new Dictionary<string, int>();

    [Fact]
    public void A()
    {
        shared.Add(1);
        counter++;
    }

    [Test]
    public void B()
    {
        counter = 5;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void C()
    {
        Items.Add(1);
        Map["a"] = 1;
        Items.Clear();
    }
}
